newsitem.title: USA: NGC sets $650 mln in '97 capital spending.
newsitem.headline: NGC sets $650 mln in '97 capital spending.

text.p: NGC Corp said on Tuesday it planned to spend about $650 million on investments, acquisitions and capital projects during 1997.

The energy products company said in a statement that about $250 million of 1997's capital budget was planned for the acquisition and expansion of the Venice, La., natural gas gathering and processing complex, construction of a new natural gas liquids fractionation facility, well connections to gas processing plants and gathering systems, and maintenance of existing facilities.
The remaining $400 million is planned for strategic energy-acquisition and construction project opportunities that complement NGC's existing businesses, the statement said.
The capital expenditures budget for 1997 is expected to be funded by internally generated cash flow and additional borrowings under the company's revolving credit facility.
